**Answer: 2400**

Three rooks don't attack each other exactly when they occupy three different rows and three different columns.

1. Choose 3 of the 6 rows: $\binom{6}{3} = 20$ ways.
2. Choose 3 of the 6 columns: $\binom{6}{3} = 20$ ways.
3. Match the chosen rows to the chosen columns one-to-one: $3! = 6$ ways.

The rooks are indistinguishable, so each set of three squares is counted once. The total is

$$\binom{6}{3}^2 \cdot 3! = 20 \cdot 20 \cdot 6 = 2400.$$

ANSWER: 2400
